rationale: Under section 3 (Trip Delay) we need the carrier's confirmation of the delay and its cause, and section 5 of the claims manual lists that as a required document; Skylark's certificate confirms the times (14h15m, so the Economy 12-hour waiting period is met) but says nothing about why the flight was late, and only your own account mentions the crew duty-hours issue. Please send a letter or email from Skylark Airways confirming the reason for the delay, quoting booking reference SK-P3M8WY, and a claims handler will finish the assessment. If the cause is confirmed as a crew problem, the two meal receipts of $29 and $42 come to $71, which is within the $300 Economy maximum with no deductible on this benefit.
